text: Per Expedia Group's 2026 proxy statement, the two largest disclosed institutional holders of its common stock are The Vanguard Group (13.3% of common stock, 9.0% of total votes) and BlackRock, Inc. (8.7% of common stock, 5.9% of total votes). However, Chairman Barry Diller holds 100% of the Class B common stock, giving him the single largest voting bloc at 32.6% of total votes — a concentrated position, not the dispersed float with no controlling shareholder that the previous text described.
